### Day 278: Acts 21:15–25
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-278-acts-21-1525.html
Passage: Acts 21:20-21
Points:
- Paul received an initial warm welcome from church leaders who glorified God for his Gentile ministry.
- The elders shared their apprehension regarding Jewish believers who were zealous for the Mosaic law.
- Paul encountered painful misunderstandings and false rumors from fellow Christians rather than outside enemies.
- To maintain peace, Paul submitted to the elders' counsel by participating in purification rites.
- Believers are challenged to find common ground with others without compromising the true gospel.
